message: 幼馴染みは永遠に

name: Eddie
message: 「Well, I'm heading off to Prier. Yakisoba bread, get in my hands!」

name: Synn
message: 「Good luck! Now then, I've got my bento and--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Milk, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「How'd you know?! Even you, Sacchin?!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「'Cause you always have it--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Anyone could figure that out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, whatever, milk is good for you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, I've got a little errand to run!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Then I'll wait to eat--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's gonna take the whole lunch break, so don't worry about it! Anyway, see ya later!」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder what her errand is?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Same as yesterday, the toi--」
Let's not talk about that while we're eating.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Synn-kun, you don't have any idea--?」

name: Synn
message: 「None at all.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Even though you're lovers--?」

name: Synn
message: 「Who is?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Synn-kun and Nana-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「We are not!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Staaaaaaaare.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No progress, huh-- Even though you went and surpassed your master-- What are you even doing--」
Why would Sacchin suddenly start saying stuff like this?
Could it be that about kissing her, to Sacchin.
No, we already settled that between us as an accident.

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why would you think that?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Why, you ask~? Hmm, when all's said and done, you two are super close~, and you're together a lot~」

name: Synn
message: 「That's because we're childhood friends... and we're in the same class and on the Student Council together.」
I can't tell.
Unlike usual, Sacchin's expression is way harder to read today.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, hey, Lord Synn. If you keep staring at this little lady like that, she's gonna think you've got the hots for her.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Answering that fast is just rude.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ahaha~. I wouldn't get the wrong idea like that~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'd just think Synn-kun finally noticed my niche kind of cuteness~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, even I wouldn't notice something that hard to spot.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Everyone's blind as a bat~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I see~, childhood friends, huh~. Forever, and ever, and eeeever~」
Childhood friends, huh.
Yeah, that's right. A little mishap like that won't change our relationship.
I'm sure Nanaka feels the same way.
Because we're childhood friends...
No.
Even as childhood friends, there's actually something I'm keeping secret from her.
The fact that I'm the Demon Lord.
If she found out about that, maybe Nanaka would change too.
Still, what if our positions were reversed?
If Nanaka were the Demon Lord, would I change?
No, I wouldn't. Nanaka is Nanaka.
That's why I'm sure Nanaka wouldn't change either... I want to believe that.
Thinking that Nanaka would feel the exact same way just because I do.
I guess that's being a little too optimistic...
